speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. Can you tell me if you have experienced any headaches, neck stiffness, or sensitivity to light along with your fever and confusion?

speaker: Patient
text: 22-year-old male. The patient presents with a 2-day history of fever and altered mentation, reporting fever without chills and rigors. He denies sore throat, abdominal pain, headache, loose stool, burning micturition, or seizures. Has a history of tics and is currently taking haloperidol.

speaker: Doctor
text: Given your history of taking haloperidol, I need to rule out Neuroleptic Malignant Syndrome. Do you currently have any severe muscle rigidity, excessive sweating, or rapid changes in your heart rate or blood pressure?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Fever and altered mentation. I also have Profuse sweating, Generalized rigidity, Confusion and disorientation, Ability to move all limbs, Normal deep tendon reflexes with bilateral downgoing plantar responses.

speaker: Doctor
text: Those symptoms strongly suggest Neuroleptic Malignant Syndrome, so I need to confirm the metabolic and muscular status. REQUEST TEST: Creatine Kinase, Complete Blood Count, Comprehensive Metabolic Panel.
